articles.title: At TechBBQ, Europe’s AI conversations kept coming back to: Who’s actually in control?
articles.summary: Investors, founders, and operators from across Europe arrived for the annual Nordic TechBBQ conference to talk about how humans can have agency over AI.

articles.title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
articles.summary: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.

articles.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
articles.summary: Neocloud Lambda has raised $1B in private debt to buy Nvidia AI chips and lease them to Microsoft. It's the latest in a string of loans, underscoring the high cost of the AI boom.
